# CollegeRanker

> > CollegeRanker provides unbiased college rankings, major difficulty guides, and career guidance to help students make informed higher education decisions.

CollegeRanker offers comprehensive rankings of colleges and online degree programs across diverse fields, from technology and marine biology to criminal justice and fire science. The site also features in-depth guides on major difficulty, career pathways, and the college admissions process, authored by David Krug and the CollegeRanker Team.

## Key Topics

- College Rankings
- Major Difficulty Analysis
- Online Bachelor's Degrees
- Career Guidance and Pathways
- Higher Education Decisions
- Engineering Curriculum (Aerospace, Nuclear)
- Technology Colleges (MIT, Caltech)
- Online Universities (Liberty University, Purdue Global, Columbia Southern University, American Public University System)
- Legal Education (Juris Doctor, Master of Laws)
- STEM Majors and Careers
- College Admissions Process
- Affordable Education Options
- Student Challenges and Success
- Career Opportunities by Degree

## College Rankings and Program Guides

- [Best Technology Colleges [100% Unbiased]](https://www.collegeranker.com/best-technology-colleges): Rankings of top technology colleges including MIT and Caltech
- [2025 Best Marine Biology Colleges [100% Unbiased]](https://www.collegeranker.com/best-marine-biology-colleges): Rankings of top marine biology programs including UC San Diego and Miami
- [2025 Most Affordable Online Bachelors in Criminal Justice [100% Unbiased]](https://www.collegeranker.com/most-affordable-online-bachelors-in-criminal-justice): Rankings of affordable online criminal justice programs for 2025
- [2025 Most Affordable Online Bachelors in Fire Science [100% Unbiased]](https://www.collegeranker.com/most-affordable-online-bachelors-in-fire-science): Rankings of affordable online fire science programs for 2025
- [America's Fastest-Growing Colleges](https://www.collegeranker.com/fastest-growing-colleges): Rankings of fastest-growing colleges including SNHU and Western Governors

## Major Difficulty and Academic Insights

- [Is Nuclear Engineering a Hard Major? Insights from My Experience](https://www.collegeranker.com/is-nuclear-engineering-a-hard-major): Personal insights on nuclear engineering major challenges and opportunities
- [Is Supply Chain Management a Hard Major? Insights and Analysis](https://www.collegeranker.com/is-supply-chain-management-a-hard-major): Analysis of supply chain management major difficulty and career advice
- [Is Music a Hard Major? Unveiling the Truth](https://www.collegeranker.com/is-music-a-hard-major): Analysis of music major challenges and career guidance for students
- [Is plant science a hard major?](https://www.collegeranker.com/is-plant-science-a-hard-major): Examines plant science major difficulty and STEM career opportunities

## Career Pathways and Degree Information

- [What Degree Do You Need To Become A Lawyer?](https://www.collegeranker.com/what-degree-do-you-need-to-become-a-lawyer): Guide to law degrees including Juris Doctor and legal career requirements
- [What is an Associate of Science Degree Good For?](https://www.collegeranker.com/what-is-an-associate-of-science-degree-good-for): Explores career paths and opportunities with Associate of Science degree
- [What Other Jobs Can You Do with a CNA License?](https://www.collegeranker.com/what-other-jobs-can-you-do-with-a-cna-license): Career options and healthcare jobs available with CNA certification
- [What Companies are in the Technology Field?](https://www.collegeranker.com/what-companies-are-in-the-technology-field): Overview of major tech companies like Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon

## College Admissions and Student Life

- [What Does It Mean to Be Waitlisted for Colleges?](https://www.collegeranker.com/what-does-it-mean-to-be-waitlisted-for-colleges): Explains college waitlist process and strategies for waitlisted students
- [How Many Semesters in a Year?](https://www.collegeranker.com/how-many-semesters-in-a-year): Explains academic calendar systems: semester vs quarter scheduling
- [Which liberal arts colleges offer strong mentorship from renowned professors at an affordable price?](https://www.collegeranker.com/which-liberal-arts-colleges-offer-strong-mentorship-from-renowned-professors-at-an-affordable-price): Guide to affordable liberal arts colleges with strong faculty mentorship
